hero.lead: From Vietnam’s national root of trust to the open banking platforms of its largest banks, SAVIS technology runs in production where failure is not an option.

blocks.title: Roots of trust, time-stamping and validation for a whole country’s digital economy

items.title: Vietnam National Root CA
items.text: SAVIS designed and delivered the Vietnam National Root CA — the root of trust that anchors every public digital signature certificate in the country.

items.title: Root CA and trust services for national mobile PKI
items.text: A dedicated Root CA and trust services that let Vietnam’s mobile network operators issue digital signatures directly on subscribers’ phones.

items.title: An international, WebTrust-grade CA for cross-border trust
items.text: An international certification authority built to WebTrust requirements, so Vietnamese certificates can be recognised by Microsoft, Apple, Adobe and EU trust programmes.

items.title: National time-stamping and validation services
items.text: National TSA and VA services that prove when a document was signed and whether a certificate was valid at that moment.

items.title: Root CA and issuing CA for the national payment system
items.text: SAVIS built the Root CA and intermediate CA that secure interbank and national payment transactions for Vietnam’s central bank.

blocks.title: Qualified CAs, signing hubs and remote signing for banks and trust service providers

items.title: Sacombank’s qualified CA, from appliance to signing
items.text: A complete in-house CA for Sacombank — SAM Appliance, PKI Appliance, Signing Server, VA and RA — serving payments, open banking, digital banking, lending and e-contracts.

items.title: A turnkey QTSP and remote signing platform for Viettel-CA
items.text: SAVIS delivered remote signing, QSCD and the QTSP platform for the trust services arm of Vietnam’s largest mobile operator.

items.title: VIB Signing Hub: every signing method, one platform
items.text: A signing hub for VIB that supports remote, mobile, local and HSM-based signing — and verifies them all in one place.

items.title: TrustCA Remote Signing with VNeID for Vietnam’s leading banks
items.text: Banks and finance companies use TrustCA Remote Signing, linked to Vietnam’s VNeID national identity, to sign documents digitally from front office to back office.

blocks.title: Open API platforms and hubs built for SBV Circular 64 and PSD2

items.title: A complete Open Banking platform for Vietcombank
items.text: SAVIS delivered every module of Vietcombank’s Open Banking platform, built for SBV Circular 64 and aligned with PSD2.

items.title: Designing a national Open Banking Hub for NAPAS
items.text: Consulting, design and pilot of an Open Banking Hub that connects banks, credit institutions and merchants through one national switch.

items.title: Open Banking Platform for the VPBank Open API ecosystem
items.text: A full-module Open Banking Platform that powers VPBank’s Open API ecosystem for partners and fintechs.

blocks.title: Citizen apps and public-service platforms for provinces and cities

items.title: iBacninh: one app between the city, its citizens and businesses
items.text: SAVIS developed and deployed iBacninh, the city’s digital communication platform that brings nearly 30 information channels and services into one app.

blocks.title: Certification programmes and paperless journeys for regulated institutions

items.title: From gap assessment to PCI DSS certification
items.text: SAVIS supported VPBank through PCI DSS certification, working with ControlCase as the Qualified Security Assessor.

items.title: Paperless lending with e-contracts and e-signatures
items.text: Customers complete a loan end to end online — onboarding, contract and signature — without visiting a branch.
